detail.body:
Hello,

We are writing about a maintenance request for your home at 5 South Street. The tenant reported a slowly dripping kitchen tap on Monday 2026-10-12 at 11:00. This has been logged as work order "Leaky tap - 5 South Street."

To arrange the visit, please tell us all the time intervals when you are available. Include each day and time window that works for you, and we will schedule the visit within one of them.

Thank you,
Property Maintenance Team

Hello,

We have received a maintenance request for your home at 9 Elm Road: the heating has stopped working in the whole flat. The request was reported on Monday 2026-10-12 at 12:00 and is recorded as work order "No heating - 9 Elm Road".

To arrange a visit, please let us know all the times when you are available, as explicit date and time intervals. Please include every interval that works for you so we can find the earliest suitable slot.

Thank you,
Property Maintenance Team
